497:t_000:25.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「No problem. To draw out this unit's potential, we'll need to use 100% of our Super Soldier power too.」

497:t_000:26.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「My $$ガンダム$$'s output has gone up too after the control system review. I should be able to fight better than ever.」

497:t_000:27.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「We can use $$トランザム$$ on this one now too. Don't think it'll be the age of the $$ガンダム$$s forever.」

497:t_000:28.en:
$$グラハム$$
(My friend $$ビリー・カタギリ$$... I will master the power you gave $$ブレイヴ$$...)

497:t_000:29.en:
$$レイアム$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ approach confirmed!」

497:t_000:30.en:
$$オットー$$
「Here they come! All units, prepare to intercept!!」

497:t_001:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you came, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_001:2.en:
$$レズン$$
「All units, deploy! How convenient, $$シャア・アズナブル$$ is out on the front line too!」

497:t_001:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Not that many of them came, huh.」

497:t_001:4.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「It could be an advance party. We can't let our guard down.」

497:t_001:5.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Then all that's left is to swiftly take down their commander...!」

497:t_001:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's right! I'm counting on you, $$赤い彗星$$!」

497:t_001:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「So the time has come to settle things with $$ギュネイ$$.」

497:t_001:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't worry, $$クェス$$. I've thought about how to settle things with him in my own way.」

497:t_001:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「First I make contact with $$ギュネイ$$...! I can't let him go on being a man who fights for personal reasons!」

497:t_001:12.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「So you're coming, $$シャア$$! And $$カミーユ$$ too!」

497:t_001:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Today I'm going to stop you for good, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_001:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's not just you! I will stop a $$ネオ・ジオン$$ that has lost its way!」

497:t_002:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you came, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_002:2.en:
$$レズン$$
「All units, deploy! How convenient, $$シャア・アズナブル$$ is out on the front line too!」

497:t_002:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Not that many of them came, huh.」

497:t_002:4.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「It could be an advance party. We can't let our guard down.」

497:t_002:5.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Then all that's left is to swiftly take down their commander...!」

497:t_002:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's right! I'm counting on you, $$赤い彗星$$!」

497:t_002:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「So the time has come to settle things with $$ギュネイ$$.」

497:t_002:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「Understand, $$クェス$$. I can't let him go on being a man who fights for personal reasons any longer.」

497:t_002:11.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「So you're coming, $$シャア$$! And $$カミーユ$$ too!」

497:t_002:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll stop you here, $$ギュネイ$$!」

497:t_002:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's not just you! I will stop a $$ネオ・ジオン$$ that has lost its way!」

497:t_003:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Not yet! You still won't go down!?」

497:t_003:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「Stop it already, $$ギュネイ$$! You don't really think $$フロンタル$$'s way is right either!」

497:t_003:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Even so! Now that the Colonel is gone, I'm the one who'll change $$ネオ・ジオン$$ from the inside!」

497:t_003:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Throw away the name of $$ジオン$$! You can't move forward if you cling to something like that!」

497:t_003:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're the last one who should say that!」

497:t_004:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Do you have any idea how much hope Spacenoids placed in the name of $$ジオン$$!?」

497:t_004:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$ジオン$$ will change the world... It will change the lives of the people living in this barren space...」

497:t_004:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Say what you said earlier again, in front of the people who believed in that, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

497:t_004:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Why are you silent, Colonel!」

497:t_004:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't you fight to save all people, with no $$ジオン$$ and no Federation!」

497:t_004:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And you don't need to carry everyone's future on your shoulders alone!」

497:t_004:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop chasing the Colonel's back, $$ギュネイ$$! If you want to save the Spacenoids, do it with your own strength!」

497:t_004:13.en:
$$クェス$$
「You're a man, aren't you, $$ギュネイ$$! Show me you can surpass the Colonel!」

497:t_004:16.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up, $$カミーユ$$! I can't move forward unless I defeat the Colonel!」

497:t_005:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「People's wills are gathering in $$ゼータ$$...!」

497:t_005:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The universe... is filled with human souls...」

497:t_005:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I can understand $$カミーユ$$'s words...」

497:t_005:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll show you what it means... what that power is, you who waste lives on your emotions!!」

497:t_007:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He's all right. He must have understood what my words meant.」

497:t_007:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So he... believed in the god of space too?」

497:t_007:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Only humans have the power to change God... to change the future... That is the god called possibility.」

497:t_007:6.en:
$$シャア$$
(I'm sorry, $$ギュネイ$$... My own shortcomings made you suffer...)

497:t_007:7.en:
$$シャア$$
(I've made up my mind too. In this battle...)

497:t_007:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Watch out! The main force is coming!」

497:t_008:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If he keeps fighting like this, obsessed with the Colonel, all that awaits him is ruin...」
